title: Aircraft Engine Starter/Generator (Refurb)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.419TH CSB.W6QM MICC-FT DRUM
description_text: BRAND NAME OR EQUAL Aftermarket Aircraft Part. Part Number 300SGL145Q is a STARTER GENERATOR manufactured or catalogued by Skurka Aerospace (APC) Must be a remanufactured aircraft starter generator. Must be compatible and work on Cessna 208B Grand Caravan Aircraft with PT6-114A PRATT WHITNEY ENGINE. Starter Generator must have amperage between 290 - 310. Cannot be more than 14.5inch in length, 10inch wide or 8inch in height. Must weight between 30 - 33lbs.
